narrative_purpose: Ground the tree's two strongest shared characters in bodies rather than abstractions: radically different land, sea, flying, and humanoid forms all reveal the same grown carbon-composite skeleton and the same exposed neural-queue architecture.
subject: A comparative xenobiology bench holding four distinct Pandoran specimens in matched study views: a Na'vi upper torso, a thanator head and forequarter, an ikran wing root, and a tulkun flipper base. Each specimen has one small clean anatomical window exposing dark woven carbon-composite fibres inside a hollow or lightweight bone, and each also shows a neural queue or homologous connector ending in a fan of fine pink-cyan tendrils. The four exteriors remain unmistakably different while the two hidden structures repeat.
scene: A museum-like naturalist study plate against deep indigo, with no laboratory text or interface, the specimens arranged as observations from land, air, and sea.
camera: Consistent three-quarter anatomical study angles, close enough to compare the repeated bone texture and neural tendril fans.
light: Cool specimen light rakes across skin and bone windows; the neural tendrils glow softly from within in cyan and magenta; deep shadow separates the specimens.
palette: Void indigo ground, ocean teal and stone-grey anatomy, near-black woven bone fibres, Pandora cyan and restrained biolum magenta in neural tissue.
style: Painterly speculative-biology comparative anatomy plate, hand-painted, field-guide precision without schematic labels.
detail_level: High detail on the repeated carbon-fibre weave and tendril-fan architecture; exterior bodies are clear but secondary.
composition: Four specimens in a balanced horizontal sequence with their bone windows aligned across one visual band and their neural connectors visible at a second band, allowing pattern recognition without arrows.
consistency_notes: The four bodies must remain recognisably Na'vi, thanator, ikran, and tulkun. The repeated internal traits are homologous in visual construction, not identical pasted icons.
negative_prompt: no text, no labels, no arrows, no phylogenetic tree, no charts, no gore, no cybernetic cables, no photographic dissection, no glossy 3D render, no cartoon or anime style
